# GL Reconciler

`GRADED` `READ-ONLY` `HUMAN-APPROVAL` `INJECTION-AWARE`

Anthropic's GL-to-subledger reconciliation agent: finds breaks over threshold, traces each to its cause, re-verifies, and drafts an exception report for sign-off. Reads through GL and subledger MCP servers you connect.

**What it can do:** Only reads; changes nothing.

## Why these badges

- **`READ-ONLY`** — Produces a report; it states "No ledger posting" and adjustments need human approval outside the agent.
- **`HUMAN-APPROVAL`** — The exception report is routed for controller sign-off.
- **`INJECTION-AWARE`** — Custodian and counterparty statements are untrusted; their readers have no MCP access or write tools.
